messages.text: Hello, I sent an email late last night regarding a warranty issue on having with my tax I checked power and my screen and all fans are down. I’m currently not hashing and need to get this fixed as soon as possible please

Sorry, that's a frustrating one. A unit with no screen and no fans spinning is almost always the PSU, not the miner, and we do PSU-only replacements, so you may not need to send the whole thing back.

Two things from me: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? And start the RMA here, it's the only intake and it gets you a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

For fastest hands-on help, JD (@nullhashrate) is on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
